data.name: DTR_NextBestActionsConfigurationIssue
data.value: AI suggestion configuration is incomplete.
data.comment: Issue message when NBA or IBS configuration is incomplete.

data.name: DTR_NextBestActionsConfigurationSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Productivity > Intent-based suggestions, and enable the target surface for the current experience profile.
data.comment: Solution message for completing NBA or IBS configuration.

data.name: DTR_EnableIntentProvisioningSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Productivity > Intent-based suggestions, and save the page with the target suggestion type enabled. If intent provisioning still does not complete, go to Customer Intent Agent and enable intent provisioning.
data.comment: Solution message for enabling intent provisioning for NBA or IBS.

data.name: DTR_VerifyCopilotSettingsSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Productivity > Copilot settings, verify the Copilot settings record exists, and enable the required Copilot settings.
data.comment: Solution message for missing Copilot settings.

data.name: DTR_EnableCopilotSidePaneSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Productivity > Copilot settings, and turn on the Copilot side pane.
data.comment: Solution message for enabling the Copilot side pane.

data.name: DTR_EnableKnowledgeSourceSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Productivity > Copilot settings, and turn on Dynamics 365 knowledge as a Copilot source.
data.comment: Solution message for enabling Dynamics 365 knowledge as a Copilot source.

data.name: DTR_EnableSuggestedContentSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Productivity > Intent-based suggestions, and turn on Suggested content.
data.comment: Solution message for enabling the suggested content target surface.

data.name: DTR_EnableActionsSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Productivity > Intent-based suggestions, and turn on Actions.
data.comment: Solution message for enabling the actions target surface.

data.name: DTR_EnableCurrentExperienceProfileSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Productivity > Intent-based suggestions, select the current experience profile, and save.
data.comment: Solution message for enabling NBA or IBS for the current experience profile.

data.name: DTR_VerifyExperienceProfileAssignmentSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Workspaces > Agent experience profiles, and verify the current user is assigned to a valid experience profile.
data.comment: Solution message for verifying experience profile assignment.

data.name: DTR_ConfigureProductivityPaneSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Workspaces > Agent experience profiles, open the current profile, and configure the productivity pane.
data.comment: Solution message for configuring the productivity pane.

data.name: DTR_VerifyProductivityPaneSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Workspaces > Agent experience profiles, open the current profile, and verify the productivity pane configuration.
data.comment: Solution message for verifying productivity pane configuration.

data.name: DTR_EnableProductivityPaneSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Workspaces > Agent experience profiles, open the current profile, and enable the productivity pane.
data.comment: Solution message for enabling the productivity pane.

data.name: DTR_EnableCopilotToolTabSolution
data.value: Open Customer Service admin center, go to Workspaces > Agent experience profiles, open the current profile, and enable the Copilot tool tab in the productivity pane.
data.comment: Solution message for enabling the Copilot tool tab.
